saw_lines: Campers buy a portable toilet only after checking how it empties, whether it smells, and what owners report.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer decides whether the toilet is for them.
Your site shows 1665 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads use any proof number. Put 1665 reviews on the creative and in line one.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 29 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 1665 reviews and 100,000+ customers, yet 0 of 30 ads use any proof number, so cold buyers have nothing to trust. Put 1665 reviews on the creative and in the first line, and open two ads with a review quote.

5 of your 9 copy ads open on the same great outdoors line, so those ads sound alike and the first line never names the toilet. Test three new openers on no dump point, the separating design and setup in minutes.
The offer appears after 79% of the copy on a median ad of 107 words, so a buyer reads the whole ad before any reason to act. Put free shipping in the first two lines of every copy ad.
One exact copy runs in 3 of your 9 copy ads, so those buyers see the same pitch three times. Keep the copy, change the opening line and visual in each, leading with a review quote.

ads_1: Toilet-first openers on no dump point and separating design, replacing the outdoors line
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
